name: Ministry Blade
desc: A secret-police duelist from Vantor, trained from childhood and unfailingly polite.

intro: A slim figure in Ministry grey offers you a small bow, and then a choice of where you'd like to be wounded first.
A Ministry Blade removes one glove, salutes you with a thin saber, and asks you to please begin.
hit: You don't see the saber move. You only see the neat line it left across your sleeve.
The blade flicks past your guard and back. "First lesson," says the duelist, not even breathing hard.
A thin cut opens across your knuckles, and the duelist corrects your grip with the flat of the blade.
miss: The saber stops a finger's width from your eye, and the duelist tuts at themselves.
You parry more by luck than anything, and the duelist raises an eyebrow at you, pleased.
You stumble back out of reach, and the duelist waits for you to find your feet, as good manners require.
crit: It's a beautiful piece of swordwork, and you're still admiring it when your knees give.
defeated: The duelist lowers the saber, touches their own wound, and looks at you as if you've said something rude.
The duelist falls in good order, and from the floor asks you to note the time.
joins: {Enemy} arrives without hurrying, and waits for a gap in the fighting to bow to you.
stunned: {Enemy} takes one careful step back and holds their guard, blinking, and doesn't come at you.
persuade_failed: The blade agrees with everything you say, thanks you for saying it, and doesn't stop.
lie_worked: You give a Ministry countersign you once overheard, in the right order. The blade bows, apologizes for the misunderstanding, and leaves without a sound.
